sentences.translation: 沿河岸长着一丛丛芦苇。

sentences.sentence: The proposals before the legislature include the creation of two special courts to deal exclusively with violent crimes.
sentences.translation: 摆在议会面前的提案包括建立两个特殊法庭专门审理暴力犯罪案件。

sentences.sentence: With the baboon you first reward a hop, then a bigger hop, then an even bigger hop.
sentences.translation: 对狒狒，你先奖励它的小进步，然后是大一点的进步，接着是更大的进步。

sentences.sentence: We found a very developed foetus from the bat, and the baboon gave birth five days after the event was witnessed.
sentences.translation: 我们发现蝙蝠体内有一个很成熟的胎儿，那只狒狒也在此事过后五天生了幼仔。

phrases.translation: 光楔；光学劈片；光学梯尺

sentences.sentence: Garnish with lemon wedges.
sentences.translation: 用几角柠檬片作装饰。

phrases.translation: 嵌入水印；嵌入水印滤镜

sentences.sentence: One of the bullets passed through Andrea's chest before embedding itself in a wall.
sentences.translation: 其中一颗子弹穿过安德烈亚的胸膛然后嵌入一面墙中。

sentences.sentence: The real nose however is the blowhole on top of the head.
sentences.translation: 而真正的鼻孔其实是它们头顶的喷水孔。

sentences.translation: 电视机天线

sentences.sentence: ...the information receptors in our brain.
sentences.translation: …我们大脑中的信息感受器。

sentences.sentence: Its colors are green, magenta, orange and blue.
sentences.translation: 它的颜色是绿色，品红色，橙色以及蓝色。

sentences.sentence: I painted the previously white trim dark green and the doors this insane magenta.
sentences.translation: 原来白色的门框被我涂成了深绿色，门则是这种品红色。

sentences.sentence: Green and red light mix to produce yellow, red and blue light mix to produce magenta, green and blue mix to produce cyan.
sentences.translation: 绿光和红光叠加可产生黄色，红光与蓝光叠加可产生品红色，绿光与蓝光叠加可产生青绿色。

sentences.sentence: an armed rebellion
sentences.translation: 武装叛乱

sentences.sentence: Madame Curie will always be remembered as the discoverer of radium.
sentences.translation: 居里夫人作为镭的发现者将永远为人们所怀念。

sentences.sentence: In general, comets are named after their discoverer, either a person.
sentences.translation: 总的来说，彗星是以发现者，或者说是人的名字命名的。

sentences.sentence: The Mozart’s frog’s whistle-like call resembles musical notes when mapped as an audiospectrogram, a fact that inspired discoverer Blair Hedges to name the species after the famed composer.
sentences.translation: 莫扎特蛙口哨般的叫声在声谱图上的反应就像音符一般，受此启发，发现者布莱尔·赫齐斯用那著名的作曲家的名字给这个物种命名。

sentences.sentence: cooking over a charcoal fire
sentences.translation: 在炭火上做饭

sentences.sentence: Red squirrels cut conifer cones from trees and bury them in plant litter on the forest floor.
sentences.translation: 红松鼠会将针叶树上的果实割下来，然后埋在森林地面的落叶中。

sentences.sentence: To get annual temperatures, they measured rings in high-altitude conifer trees, which grow faster in warmer summers and slower in colder years.
sentences.translation: 为了得出每年的气温值，他们对生长在高海拔地区的针叶树的年轮进行测量，这种树木在炎烈的夏天生长得比较快，而在寒冷的年份就长得比较慢。

sentences.sentence: A botanist can differentiate varieties of plants.
sentences.translation: 植物学家能区分各种不同的植物。

sentences.sentence: Along with English botanist Joseph Hooker, Lyell was one of a small handful of people Darwin had shown early drafts of his own work on natural selection.
sentences.translation: 同英国植物学家约瑟夫·胡克一样，莱尔是少数了解达尔文在自然选择学说方面研究的早期草稿的人之一。

sentences.sentence: Forty-five years on, the French botanist's gardens have grown massive in scale.
sentences.translation: 四十五年过去，这法国植物学家的花园规模更大。

sentences.sentence: “I can never look now at the Milky Way”, said the narrator in “The Sentinel”, “without wondering from which of those banked clouds of stars the emissaries are coming.
sentences.translation: “现在，我再也看不到银河了。” 在《哨兵》中，他借叙述者的口说道，“没错，那层层叠叠的星云中，我们期待的使者正在向这里赶来。

sentences.sentence: In Benjamin the important thing, as I think we've said, is the idea that the narrator is the apparatus.
sentences.translation: 本杰明的这个作品，很重要的一点，我觉得我们已经说过了，就是叙述者是机器。

sentences.sentence: Mike looked at her critically.
sentences.translation: 迈克挑剔地打量着她。

sentences.sentence: He has spoken critically of the government’s refusal to support the industry.
sentences.translation: 他谈到政府拒绝支持这个行业时颇有微词。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 199 单元

monetary
音标：英 /'mʌnɪt(ə)rɪ/  美 /'mʌnɪtɛri/
adj. 货币的, 金融的
短语：monetary policy — 货币政策
短语：international monetary fund — 国际货币基金组织
短语：monetary system — 货币制度
短语：international monetary system — 国际货币制度
短语：monetary authority — 货币当局；金融管理专员
短语：monetary unit — [经]货币单位
短语：tight monetary policy — 紧缩的货币政策；紧缩信用政策
短语：monetary union — 货币联盟
短语：monetary value — 货币价值；货币值；币值
短语：monetary base — [经]货币基础
短语：fiscal and monetary policy — 财政金融政策
短语：european monetary union — 欧洲货币联盟
短语：monetary crisis — 货币危机；金融危机
短语：prudent monetary policy — 稳健的货币政策；谨慎的货币政策
短语：monetary reward — 金钱奖赏；赏金
短语：monetary policy committee — 货币政策委员会
短语：monetary assets — 货币资产
短语：monetary capital — 货币资本；金融资本
短语：monetary economics — 货币经济学
例句：the government’s tight monetary policy
政府从紧的货币政策
例句：objects of little monetary value
不值钱的物件

reed
音标：英 /riːd/  美 /rid/
n. 芦苇
短语：reed valve — 簧片阀
短语：reed switch — 舌簧开关；簧片开关
短语：reed pipe — 簧管；牧笛
短语：reed flute cave — 芦笛岩
短语：john reed — 约翰·里德（花旗银行主席和首席执行官）
例句：Reeds grew in clumps all along the river bank.
沿河岸长着一丛丛芦苇。

legislature
音标：英 /'ledʒɪslətʃə/  美 /'lɛdʒɪsletʃɚ/
n. 立法机关
例句：The proposals before the legislature include the creation of two special courts to deal exclusively with violent crimes.
摆在议会面前的提案包括建立两个特殊法庭专门审理暴力犯罪案件。

baboon
音标：英 /bə'buːn/  美 /bæ'buːn/
n. [动]狒狒
例句：With the baboon you first reward a hop, then a bigger hop, then an even bigger hop.
对狒狒，你先奖励它的小进步，然后是大一点的进步，接着是更大的进步。
例句：We found a very developed foetus from the bat, and the baboon gave birth five days after the event was witnessed.
我们发现蝙蝠体内有一个很成熟的胎儿，那只狒狒也在此事过后五天生了幼仔。

wedge
音标：英 /wedʒ/  美 /wɛdʒ/
n. 楔 vt楔入, 楔进
短语：wedge in — 挤入；插入
短语：wedge angle — 楔角；研磨角；尖角
短语：wedge block — 楔块；楔合块；楔形块
短语：wedge shape — 楔形
短语：slot wedge — 槽楔；槽边缘
短语：double wedge — 双楔翼形，菱形翼形
短语：wedge heel — 坡跟鞋；楔形跟
短语：optical wedge — 光楔；光学劈片；光学梯尺
例句：Garnish with lemon wedges.
用几角柠檬片作装饰。

overgraze
vt. 使过度放牧

embed
音标：英 /ɪm'bed; em-/  美 /ɪm'bɛd/
v. 使插入, 嵌入
短语：embed watermark — 嵌入水印；嵌入水印滤镜

其中一颗子弹穿过安德烈亚的胸膛然后嵌入一面墙中。

blowhole

而真正的鼻孔其实是它们头顶的喷水孔。

imagist

antenna
音标：英 /æn'tenə/  美 /æn'tɛnə/
n. 天线
短语：antenna array — 天线阵
短语：array antenna — 阵列天线
短语：receiving antenna — n. 接收天线
短语：satellite antenna — 卫星天线
短语：dipole antenna — 偶极天线
短语：transmitting antenna — [电]发射天线
短语：slot antenna — 缝隙天线；槽孔天线
短语：monopole antenna — 单极天线
短语：directional antenna — 定向天线
短语：antenna gain — 天线增益
短语：horn antenna — 号角天线
短语：community antenna television — 电缆电视；公用天线电视
短语：adaptive antenna — 自适应天线
短语：antenna beam — 天线波束；天线射束
短语：wire antenna — 导线天线
短语：helical antenna — 螺旋形天线
短语：parabolic antenna — [电]抛物形天线
短语：active antenna — 有源天线；发射天线
短语：loop antenna — 回路天线；环形天线；框形天线
短语：omnidirectional antenna — 全向天线
例句：television antennas
电视机天线

receptor
音标：英 /rɪ'septə/  美 /rɪ'sɛptɚ/
n. 接受器
短语：insulin receptor — n. 胰岛素受体
短语：hormone receptor — [医]激素受体；[医]荷尔蒙受体
短语：receptor protein — 受体蛋白质
短语：receptor site — 受点，受体部位
例句：...the information receptors in our brain.
…我们大脑中的信息感受器。

magenta
音标：英 /mə'dʒentə/  美 /mə'dʒɛntə/
n&a. 红紫色(的)
例句：Its colors are green, magenta, orange and blue.
它的颜色是绿色，品红色，橙色以及蓝色。
例句：I painted the previously white trim dark green and the doors this insane magenta.
原来白色的门框被我涂成了深绿色，门则是这种品红色。
例句：Green and red light mix to produce yellow, red and blue light mix to produce magenta, green and blue mix to produce cyan.
绿光和红光叠加可产生黄色，红光与蓝光叠加可产生品红色，绿光与蓝光叠加可产生青绿色。

valse
v. 轻轻地走
n. 华尔兹

rebellion
音标：英 /rɪ'beljən/  美 /rɪ'bɛljən/
n. 反叛，反抗
短语：boxer rebellion — 义和团运动
例句：an armed rebellion
武装叛乱

discoverer
音标：美 /dis'kʌvərə/
n. 发现者
例句：Madame Curie will always be remembered as the discoverer of radium.
居里夫人作为镭的发现者将永远为人们所怀念。
例句：In general, comets are named after their discoverer, either a person.
总的来说，彗星是以发现者，或者说是人的名字命名的。
例句：The Mozart’s frog’s whistle-like call resembles musical notes when mapped as an audiospectrogram, a fact that inspired discoverer Blair Hedges to name the species after the famed composer.
莫扎特蛙口哨般的叫声在声谱图上的反应就像音符一般，受此启发，发现者布莱尔·赫齐斯用那著名的作曲家的名字给这个物种命名。

charcoal
音标：英 /'tʃɑːkəʊl/  美 /'tʃɑrkol/
n. 木炭
短语：activated charcoal — 活性炭
短语：charcoal powder — 木炭粉
短语：wood charcoal — 木炭
短语：charcoal drawing — 素描
例句：cooking over a charcoal fire
在炭火上做饭

conifer
音标：英 /'kɒnɪfə; 'kəʊn-/  美 /'kɑnəfɚ/
n. [植]松类, 针叶树
例句：Red squirrels cut conifer cones from trees and bury them in plant litter on the forest floor.
红松鼠会将针叶树上的果实割下来，然后埋在森林地面的落叶中。
例句：To get annual temperatures, they measured rings in high-altitude conifer trees, which grow faster in warmer summers and slower in colder years.
为了得出每年的气温值，他们对生长在高海拔地区的针叶树的年轮进行测量，这种树木在炎烈的夏天生长得比较快，而在寒冷的年份就长得比较慢。

botanist
音标：英 /'bɒtənɪst/  美 /'bɑtənɪst/
n. 植物学家
例句：A botanist can differentiate varieties of plants.
植物学家能区分各种不同的植物。
例句：Along with English botanist Joseph Hooker, Lyell was one of a small handful of people Darwin had shown early drafts of his own work on natural selection.
同英国植物学家约瑟夫·胡克一样，莱尔是少数了解达尔文在自然选择学说方面研究的早期草稿的人之一。
例句：Forty-five years on, the French botanist's gardens have grown massive in scale.
四十五年过去，这法国植物学家的花园规模更大。

narrator
音标：英 /nə'reɪtə/  美 /næ'retɚ/
n. 讲述者
例句：“I can never look now at the Milky Way”, said the narrator in “The Sentinel”, “without wondering from which of those banked clouds of stars the emissaries are coming.
“现在，我再也看不到银河了。” 在《哨兵》中，他借叙述者的口说道，“没错，那层层叠叠的星云中，我们期待的使者正在向这里赶来。
例句：In Benjamin the important thing, as I think we've said, is the idea that the narrator is the apparatus.
本杰明的这个作品，很重要的一点，我觉得我们已经说过了，就是叙述者是机器。

critically
音标：英 /'krɪtɪklɪ/  美 /'krɪtɪkli/
adv. 批评性地, 危急地
短语：critically ill — 危重症；垂危
例句：Mike looked at her critically.
迈克挑剔地打量着她。
例句：He has spoken critically of the government’s refusal to support the industry.
他谈到政府拒绝支持这个行业时颇有微词。
